component.name: ADB Deck
component.summary: Manage and debug Android devices over adb

description.p: ADB Deck is a desktop companion for Android Debug Bridge. It lists connected devices and offers a file browser, app manager, process list, live performance charts, an interactive shell, a layout inspector, screenshots, a log viewer, packet capture, WebView inspection, an on-screen remote control, wireless connection and pairing, port forwarding, APK signing and screen mirroring.
Phones that were connected once are remembered and reconnected after a restart, on Wi-Fi, over USB tethering or on a hotspot, by a background service that needs no open window.
It uses the adb and apksigner programs installed on your system and does not download them. Screen mirroring is built in and ships the scrcpy 3.1 device server (Apache-2.0).
